Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit

Class LegacyImplicitAccessTokenToken

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.security.authentication.AbstractAuthenticationToken
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit.LegacyImplicitAccessTokenToken
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Principal, org.springframework.security.core.Authentication, org.springframework.security.core.CredentialsContainer
public class LegacyImplicitAccessTokenToken extends org.springframework.security.authentication.AbstractAuthenticationToken
The result of a granted legacy implicit request: the access token and what the response needs to send it to the client in the fragment of its redirect URI.
